purpose: Compose provider-neutral payment tenders and bind attempts and settlements to exact intent capacity.
rules: Tender methods must be allowed by the intent policy.
Tender count cannot exceed max_tenders and tender numbers are contiguous.
Active tender amounts cannot exceed the intent amount.
When mixed tender is disabled the single tender must exactly equal the intent amount.
Mixed-tender attempts and settlements require explicit tender authority.
A tender-bound attempt must match intent, organization, currency, method and amount.
A settlement cannot exceed its tender and must use the same tender as its attempt.
Tender lifecycle evidence is append-only and monetary truth is immutable.
Provider-specific callback and adapter behavior remains outside M4.4.
